source: Josh's status effects (22 Nov 2026), with the rest from Bestiary: Volume I
rules: Each 2 on the status dice applies one stack. *Hard control* means stun, paralysis, sleep and petrification. When a hard control ends, the creature can't be hard-controlled again until the end of its next turn.

statuses.name: Stun
statuses.effect: Miss a turn of action. Each stack is 1 turn
statuses.ends: When the turns run out. Hard control

statuses.name: Staggered
statuses.effect: STR check: fall on a fail. Standing up takes an action
statuses.ends: Standing up

statuses.name: Paralysis
statuses.effect: WIS save. Unable to move, but can still take certain actions. Each stack is 1 turn
statuses.ends: When the turns run out. Hard control

statuses.name: Bleed
statuses.effect: Lose 0.5% of max HP or 1 HP, whichever is higher, per stack, each turn
statuses.ends: Bandages stop it: 1 bandage per 3 stacks

statuses.name: Burn
statuses.effect: Lose 3 HP per stack, each turn
statuses.ends: An action per stack clears it

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.effect: Disadvantage on a random roll type, and disadvantage on death saves
statuses.ends: A STR save at the end of each turn removes 1 stack. Clears after combat

statuses.name: Confusion
statuses.effect: INT save. All attacks have a chance to strike the wrong target. Each stack is 1 turn
statuses.ends: An INT save at the end of each turn ends it

statuses.name: Fear
statuses.effect: INT save. Disadvantage on all rolls while the source of fear is visible. Each stack is 1 turn
statuses.ends: An INT save at the end of each turn ends it

statuses.name: Toxic
statuses.effect: 5 damage each turn
statuses.ends: Not set

statuses.name: Freeze
statuses.effect: Half the value of rolled dice
statuses.ends: Fire clears all

statuses.name: Charm
statuses.effect: Becomes friendly. Each stack is 1 turn
statuses.ends: A WIS save at the end of each turn ends it

statuses.name: Exhaustion
statuses.effect: Each stack is a level
statuses.ends: Not set
levels: Roll 2d3 with every roll: a 2 means the roll fails
Roll 1d2 with every roll: a 1 means death

statuses.name: Disease
statuses.effect: One step towards sickness. At 3 stacks it catches the disease
statuses.ends: Loses 1 stack per long rest, or with medicine

statuses.name: Madness
statuses.effect: At the start of its turn, roll a d20. If the roll is equal to or under its stacks, it acts randomly
statuses.ends: Loses 1 stack per long rest, or with a tier 3 cleansing

statuses.name: Wither
statuses.effect: −1d10 max HP
statuses.ends: Long rest

statuses.name: Corrode
statuses.effect: −1 armour Min hit
statuses.ends: Repair

statuses.name: Sleep
statuses.effect: Asleep 1 turn
statuses.ends: Hard control. Damage wakes it

statuses.name: Blinded, dazzled, deafened, disorientated
statuses.effect: 1 turn. Dazzled means disadvantage on attacks
statuses.ends: Ends when the duration runs out

statuses.name: Prone
statuses.effect: Knocked down
statuses.ends: Standing up costs half its movement

statuses.name: Knockback
statuses.effect: 10 ft
statuses.ends: Instant

statuses.name: Restrained, grabbed, entangled, crushed
statuses.effect: No stacks
statuses.ends: A STR save to escape
